Scope addition from the contract review of PR #30632 (record 6667636753, ④ should-fix), read by the seat in `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-deferred-ddl.ts` (`flushDeferredSchemaDdl`, ~L65–89 on `main`): `os migrate apply` hands every deferred object to one `initObjects(pending)` call after clearing the deferred set, so one refused `_id` table with rows stops the batch mid-loop: objects after it on the same datasource get no DDL this run and the `performed` list is lost with the throw. Expected, beside the plan entry this card already asks for: apply reports the refusal per table and carries on with the rest, and the performed list survives.
